name: Breadcrumb

props.name: noTrailingSlash
props.description: Optional prop to omit the trailing slash for the breadcrumbs

props.name: size
props.description: Specify the size of the Breadcrumb. Currently supports the following: `sm` & `md` (default: 'md')

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon Breadcrumb rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
